title: Subscription cancellation claim
summary: A notice claims a subscription will renew and asks you to call, pay, or sign in.
scenario: The cancellation path is controlled by the incoming message rather than your existing account.
warning_signs: Phone number or link supplied only by the notice
Pressure to share payment or login details
safe_actions: Check subscriptions in the app or account you already use
Do not call the displayed number or disclose a code
Contact the merchant through known details
recovery_guidance: Contact the payment provider for an unfamiliar charge
Change credentials if entered into an untrusted page
reporting_guidance: Keep the notice and payment records
Use independently checked support or reporting routes
prevention_tips: Manage subscriptions from the original service
Review payment alerts without clicking their links
false_positive_notes: Real renewal reminders exist; the existing account remains the safer place to manage them.
